scope: Shared full-feed public XMLTV metadata for missing personal live-TV guide and logos

rules.guide: Only when no manual or list-declared guide exists; disabled, unavailable or partial personal guides remain authoritative
rules.logo: Only when no nonempty logo is declared, even if the declared URL is invalid or fails
rules.identity: Exact XMLTV ID, canonical ID, then unique normalized name; conflicts, incompatible Rai 3 regions and timeshifts are rejected
rules.playback: Original channel identity, source, stream and credentials retained; public EPG does not grant archive playback
rules.privacy: Full public index is not included in catalog JSON; public logo transport never uses personal source headers or cookies

public_feed.live_fetch: HTTP 429 with Retry-After 2381 seconds; reused existing downloaded cache without changing its timestamp

checks.parser_and_index: Extra channels, atomic invalid-feed rejection, backup recovery, ambiguity, regions and +1
checks.metadata_precedence: Independent provided-logo and personal-guide priorities, exclusions, VOD separation, home/catalog/channel/next/playback/window
checks.real_local_api: Public programme and cached PNG responses; no personal URL or header in catalog payloads

limits: The cached feed contains only Sky TG24 among the sample Sky channels; no guide is invented for absent channels.
Coverage is a point-in-time sample of the public feed, not a guarantee for all 157 channels.
The new native build was compiled and signed; current playback was deliberately kept in its existing process.
